name: Bao
source:
Born on a cursed day that only occurs every 200 years, Bao's parents abandoned him at a temple. At age 12, he began exhibiting strange powers. The head priest handed him over to Chin Gentsai, who became his caretaker and teacher. He joins Team Psycho Soldier, but for some reason in this work he's with Ryo.
Bao tries to live like any normal 12 year old. Happy-go-lucky and eccentric, he enjoys online games and fishing.
